function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. I can’t tell you the current temperature in Tel Aviv right now. If you’d like, I can suggest some reliable sources where you can check the latest forecast.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How does it feel now in Tel Aviv, in farenheits?" They want the current temperature in Tel Aviv in Fahrenheit. We need to provide the current temperature. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But we can provide a typical answer: "I don't have real-time data." We can also mention that we can't fetch real-time data. So we should respond that we don't have real-time data.
